name: longmemeval-mini
description: LongMemEval-style assistant-memory recall across categories: user preferences, knowledge updates, and temporal reasoning over a long session history. Hand-curated + license-clean (not the LongMemEval dataset itself).

The user prefers concise answers and dislikes long preambles.
